title.narrative: Contribution to World Economic Forum's Project "Sustainable Investment Policy and Practice"

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to develop international investment policies, frameworks and partnerships conducive to increasing the flow of long-term investments for growth and sustainable development. The project falls under Danish Aid for Trade program’s Priority Area 1: Connecting SMEs to global and regional value chains through value adding goods and services, supported by sustainable investment, with focus on Indonesia, Cambodia, India and Ghana. The project could also contribute to the ongoing plurilateral negotiations in the WTO on a multilateral framework for Investment Facilitation for Development.

title.narrative: Workshops are held for developing country policymakers and IPAs

target.value: Capacity building on sustainable investment across multiple regions advanced. Developing country policymakers and IPAs exposed to sustainable investment policies, frameworks, and measures. A subset of developing country policymakers and IPAs engaged on sustainable investment policies, frameworks and measures.

actual.value: The following capacity building activities have taken place: - Caribbean (26 February 2021) - Africa (3-4 March 2021) - Asia Pacific (30 March 2021) - Latin America (6 May 2021) - Monthly webinars for policymakers/IPAs - Multiple global workshops/events.

target.value: At least a workshop held in each 2020 pilot economy, at least another workshop organized, and participation in at least two workshops to advance sustainable investment policies, frameworks, partnerships, and measures.

actual.value: The following workshops were held: - Ghana (4 March 2020) - Cambodia (27 August 2020) - India (27 April 2021) - Cambodia (12 May 2021, tbc) - Kenya (16 June 2021, tbc) - Multiple global workshops/events.

actual.value: The project was able to catalyse reform actions through in-country, on the ground multistakeholder work between investors and governments.
